title: Charge Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly calculates the magnitude of the charge q using the given electric field and height.

title: Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student accurately determines the external electrical force F acting on the cloud.

title: Use of Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The student appropriately applies the concept of electric field due to point charges in their calculations.

title: Direction of Force
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the direction of the external force acting on the cloud.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes correct units for charge and force in their final answers.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in calculating the force, leading to an incorrect conclusion about attraction or repulsion.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to include necessary factors in the force calculation, resulting in an incorrect answer.
